selection: Representative primary sources relevant to authentication, adversary rehearsal and quantum search; not ALL models or a universal strongest ranking.

sources.name: MITRE ATT&CK T1110
sources.decision: Use named guessing/spraying/stuffing/offline categories as trace context; execute only synthetic admission fixtures.
sources.limits: Not a tool ranking or a measured detection rate.

sources.name: MITRE D3FEND
sources.decision: Use defense vocabulary and explicit behavior-to-control mappings.
sources.limits: A mapping is not evidence a control is deployed or effective.

sources.name: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0
sources.decision: Use reviewable requirements and negative tests.
sources.limits: No ASVS certification or complete requirement coverage is claimed.

sources.name: NIST SP 800-63B-4
sources.decision: Model retry ceilings, recovery boundaries and source-specific requirements.
sources.limits: The lab is not an identity provider or a NIST conformance assessment.

sources.name: NIST CSF 2.0
sources.role: Govern, identify, protect, detect, respond, recover
sources.decision: Keep ownership, response and recovery alongside protection.
sources.limits: Framework coverage does not measure implementation strength.

sources.name: NIST SP 800-207
sources.decision: Keep planning proposals separate from enforcing authorization boundaries.
sources.limits: No network-wide enforcement or trust engine is installed.

sources.name: Apache Caldera (Incubating)
sources.decision: Adopt bounded repeatable exercise and evidence patterns; research only.
sources.limits: No agents, payloads, adversary executors or live integrations are installed.

sources.name: Atomic Red Team
sources.decision: Adopt small named fixtures and repair/retest discipline; research only.
sources.limits: No upstream test commands are imported or executed.

sources.name: NIST post-quantum cryptography
sources.decision: Record quantum threat and migration separately from toy search.
sources.limits: No custom encryption, PQC integration or cryptanalytic implementation is added.

sources.name: IBM Grover tutorial
sources.decision: Reuse the existing public three-bit oracle and inspect optional QASM.
sources.limits: CPU simulation and query-model counts are not practical quantum advantage.

sources.name: Zalka, Grover search optimality
sources.decision: Respect finite oracle assumptions and the search lower bound.
sources.limits: More sequencing does not bypass complexity or create unbounded capability.

sources.name: OWASP password storage
sources.decision: Research/reference checklist only; use established libraries for a future owning auth service.
sources.limits: This lab does not accept passwords or hashes or implement a password store.
